name: Manitoba
short: Efficiency Manitoba pays $2,000 for a ducted cold climate heat pump or $1,500 for a ductless one when it adds to electric or natural gas heat, and you can add Manitoba Hydro financing. Insulation, windows and doors, and smart thermostats have rebates too, and income-qualifying households can get free or subsidized upgrades. Get approval before you buy insulation or start any work.
